method: Actual official page read in the in-app browser, including What am I Chasing and Key Facts; factual observation snapshot, not raw HTML.

facts.scope: The Tribute to Finest '96 base variation is described as numbered to 96. No limits for its other named Refractors are supplied by this guide.
The Jack Kirby and Stan Lee cut-signature relics are each described as numbered one of one.

productFacts: The official product page names Blacklight Lava and Negative Zone Kaleidoscope base variations but does not publish a complete serial-number ladder.
Finest Autographs are described as actors paired with their characters; original PDF columns remain separately preserved.
remainingGaps: The complete parallel numbering ladder is not verified; no generic color limits are inferred.
No calendar release date is established by the guide or checklist publication.
The PDF's 100 base subject rows include duplicate numeric identities 34/034 and 41/041, and omit numeric 36 and 42; these printed values are retained.
Fantastic Science Autographs omits FS-10; no missing card or actor is invented.
